lines.t: Pacing around you, you're locking me out Building a wall out of nothing but doubt
Spittin' these words just to see if they stick Sick of the games and I'm sick of the trick
Your friends are talkin', they're whisperin' loud They wanna show you we're pleasin' the crowd
Everything hurts and it's all just a blur I am the match and you're the premium, blur
Callin' me names while you're grippin' the wheel Tell me again how you don't even feel
look at the mess that you made in the hall hoping and praying to see me just fall the world is
awaiting us pressing right in covered in scars and we're covered in sin watching us drown while
they're throwing the stones breaking our spirit and breaking our bones and the world keeps dragging
us down down down chasing a ghost that is running this town we're just a wreck on the dark dead end
Trying to fix what we can't even mend
Yeah, we're running on empty, we're losing the spark
Tearing each other right up in the dark
No, I can't find it in me
And I can't find it in you
Yeah, it hit me hard on the edge of the road
3 a.m. and I'm ready to explode
Crash to the dirt with my face in the ground
Realized I'm running right out of my time
Screaming to heaven, just losing my mind
Leaving the wreckage and hatred behind
Gave up the fight and I fell to my knees
Asking the Lord for a second of peace
Staring right into a blank bedroom wall
Nobody left for me, even a call
Hating the reflection, staring at me
Trapped in a prison and losing the key
So I just dropped to the cold bedroom floor
Decided I couldn't do this anymore
Gave all the brokenness up to the sky
Let the Lord take it and let it melt
And the world kept dragging us down, down, down
Until we both hit the dirt where the truth is found
Two broken pieces that'll never fit right
Just tearing each other apart in the night
Yeah, we're running on and
Crying for the truth
But I couldn't find it in me
And I couldn't find it in you
You pulled me straight out of the pit
He took the dark and he lit it
We didn't fix what was broken inside
But the Lord met us both where the two roads divide
Now the world can't drag us down
Cause we're finally standing on solid ground
He took the pieces that were falling apart
And the Lord put a grace right into this heart
Yeah, we stopped running
Found the one who is true
I found my peace in him
I found him too
No more fighting
No more hiding
The world tried to break us
But the Lord came and saved us
